name: Astral-Eyot
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by solar wind erosion patterns and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
the temporal distortion zone bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
